properties.sql:
select p.id,prog.c_id_prg,prog.c_annee_demarrage from app_fd_dossier_comm_org dc
join
app_fd_acces_donnees p on (p.id=dc.c_id_dossier)
join 
app_fd_insc_programme prog on (prog.c_contact_electronique_prg=p.createdBy)
where dc.c_id_commission = '#requestParam.id_commission#'
